subject: general
question: A, B, C, R, S, T and U are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table. R sits to the immediate left of U. B sits to the immediate left of C. C sits second to the left of T. A sits third to the left of U. Who sits third to the right of S?
solution:
**Given:**

R sits to the immediate left of U.

B sits to the immediate left of C.

C sits second to the left of T.

A sits third to the left of U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c2a239b205d7e249b7b051657ec9b9a1e5c6fc05c0e529cc9d222711cc0a162.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is A
